items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had a trombonist named Nathaniel Atkins, and Ed Fant

ctx.x: band of his own. He sent to Indianapolis for Raymond Syd Valentine (trumpet, and leader of the Patent Leather Kids of Gennett record fame) and Cleve Bottoms on alto sax. Duncan Schiedt dates this as late 1928, when the band was in Columbus, Ohio. The new personnel was given as: Syd Valentine, Red Harland, Sprat Morton, playing trumpets." And then here it says, "Unknown trombones." Do you know who the trombones were at that time? You're in Columbus, Ohio, 1928, Syd Valentine.
Yes. I had a trombonist named Nathaniel Atkins, and Ed Fant --
Okay, but how do you spell that, F---
